adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` is defined as `(refreshFunction: () => any, ...)` and in the sync branch it returns `fetch(...)` (a `Response`), while in the non-sync branch it returns `await refreshFunction()` (typed `any`). This makes the function effectively return `any` (or `Response | any`), so call sites compile even though they assume incompatible shapes. This is not just a type-safety nit: with `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` enabled, several updated call sites will receive a `Response` object but treat it as parsed data (e.g. `googlecalendar` uses `res?.data`, `hubspot` assigns to `HubspotToken`, `zoho-bigin` uses `tokenInfo.data`), which would break at runtime.
